name: PagerDuty Incident Response Integration
description: Integration pack for PagerDuty, providing connectivity to PagerDuty Events API v2, on-call schedule routing, automated incident escalation policies, and incident status synchronization.

capabilities.name: Production Support & Incident Management / Hypercare & Stabilization
capabilities.description: Integrates PagerDuty incident trigger, acknowledge, and resolve events via Events API v2. Integrates PagerDuty hypercare escalation schedules and rapid incident response notifications.

checklists.name: PagerDuty Integration Verification Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for PagerDuty Integration Key, escalation policy assignments, and webhook listeners.

items.statement: PagerDuty Events API v2 Integration Key triggers incidents with payload routing severity.
On-Call Escalation Policies specify primary, secondary, and manager escalation tiers.
PagerDuty Webhooks notify external ChatOps channels on incident state change (triggered, acknowledged, resolved).

reviewGates.name: PagerDuty Integration Review Gate
reviewGates.statement: The On-Call Incident Commander confirms that PagerDuty alert triggers and escalation schedules operate properly.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the PagerDuty integration confirm incident trigger dispatch and escalation routing?

obligationDefinitions.title: On-call schedules must have no uncovered escalation gaps
obligationDefinitions.description: An on-call schedule with an unfilled slot or a broken escalation policy silently fails only when an incident actually occurs; coverage must be checked proactively, not discovered during a real page.
obligationDefinitions.completionCriteria: Every on-call schedule and escalation policy has zero coverage gaps for the current and next period, confirmed within the declared cadence.

requiredEvidence.title: On-call coverage gap check
requiredEvidence.description: Schedule coverage report confirming no unfilled slots in current/next period.
